WITH batting_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker as player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT bb.match_id) as matches_played,
        COUNT(*) as balls_faced,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as total_runs,
        COALESCE(MAX(bs.runs_scored), 0) as highest_score
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT 
        player_out,
        COUNT(*) as total_dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken
    WHERE player_out IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_out
),
matches_with_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker as player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as match_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL AND bs.runs_scored IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
runs_30 AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as matches_30_plus
    FROM matches_with_runs
    WHERE match_runs >= 30
    GROUP BY player_id
),
runs_50 AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as matches_50_plus
    FROM matches_with_runs
    WHERE match_runs >= 50
    GROUP BY player_id
),
runs_100 AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as matches_100_plus
    FROM matches_with_runs
    WHERE match_runs >= 100
    GROUP BY player_id
),
bowling_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler as player_id,
        COUNT(*) as balls_bowled,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as runs_conceded,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wt.player_out IS NOT NULL THEN bb.match_id END) as wickets_taken
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id 
        AND bb.bowler = wt.player_out
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler as player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wt.player_out IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as wickets,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as runs_conceded,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY bb.bowler 
            ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wt.player_out IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) DESC, 
                    COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) ASC
        ) as rn
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id 
        AND bb.bowler = wt.player_out
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),
best_bowling_final AS (
    SELECT player_id, wickets, runs_conceded
    FROM best_bowling
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    m.role as most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    bs.total_runs,
    bs.matches_played,
    d.total_dismissals,
    CASE WHEN d.total_dismissals > 0 THEN 1.0 * bs.total_runs / d.total_dismissals ELSE 0 END as batting_average,
    bs.highest_score,
    COALESCE(r30.matches_30_plus, 0) as matches_30_plus,
    COALESCE(r50.matches_50_plus, 0) as matches_50_plus,
    COALESCE(r100.matches_100_plus, 0) as matches_100_plus,
    bs.balls_faced,
    CASE WHEN bs.balls_faced > 0 THEN 1.0 * bs.total_runs / bs.balls_faced * 100 ELSE 0 END as strike_rate,
    COALESCE(bw.wickets_taken, 0) as total_wickets,
    CASE WHEN bw.balls_bowled > 0 THEN 1.0 * bw.runs_conceded / bw.balls_bowled * 6 ELSE 0 END as economy_rate,
    bbfinal.wickets || '-' || bbfinal.runs_conceded as best_bowling
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN batting_stats bs ON p.player_id = bs.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals d ON p.player_id = d.player_out
LEFT JOIN runs_30 r30 ON p.player_id = r30.player_id
LEFT JOIN runs_50 r50 ON p.player_id = r50.player_id
LEFT JOIN runs_100 r100 ON p.player_id = r100.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling_stats bw ON p.player_id = bw.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling_final bbfinal ON p.player_id = bbfinal.player_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT player_id, mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY role) as role
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id
) m ON p.player_id = m.player_id
ORDER BY p.player_id

# Special Words Definition

## Batting Average
- Batting average is a measure of a batsman's performance, calculated by dividing the total number of runs scored by the number of times they have been dismissed. A higher batting average indicates a more consistent and successful batsman.
- Batting Average = Total Runs ÷ Total Dismissals

## Strike Rate
- In batting, strike rate indicates the scoring rate of a batsman, showing the average number of runs scored per 100 balls faced. A higher strike rate reflects an aggressive and fast-scoring batsman.
- Strike Rate = (Total Runs ÷ Balls Faced) × 100

## Wickets Taken
- Wickets taken refers to the total number of times a bowler has successfully dismissed an opposing batsman. This statistic is a core measure of a bowler's effectiveness and impact on the game.

## Economy Rate
- Economy rate measures a bowler's efficiency by indicating the average number of runs conceded per over (6 balls) bowled. A lower economy rate shows greater control and efficiency in restricting the opposition's scoring.
- Economy Rate = (Total Runs Conceded ÷ Balls Bowled) × 6

## Wickets Taken
- The number of times a bowler successfully dismisses a batsman in a single match.  This metric is a direct indicator of the bowler's effectiveness, showing how many players they were able to remove from play.

## Runs Given
- The total number of runs scored by the batting side off a particular bowler’s deliveries in a single match.  This value reflects the runs the bowler has conceded to the batting team, and a lower runs-given value is typically favorable for the bowler's performance.
